title: Automated Extraction of Concentrated Wastewater Samples using Promega HT Environmental TNA Kit
author: Dagmara Antkiewicz
materials: Prepare single use volumes of clean reagents (that are not provided in the Promega kit) each day for a batch up to 40 samples:

steps.title: Thaw concentrated samples
steps.instruction: If concentrated wastewater samples are stored frozen, remove them from the freezer and let them thaw on the benchtop.

steps.title: Label KingFisher plates
steps.instruction: Label five KingFisher Deep Well 96‑well plates as “Wash 1”, “Wash 2”, “Ethanol” (EtOH), “Elution”, and “Lysis/Bind”. Arrange samples in a checkerboard pattern to minimise well contamination during mixing.

steps.title: Prepare Wash plates
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 50 % ethanol solution to each sample well of both Wash 1 and Wash 2 plates, then add 900 µL of Wash Buffer to each well.

steps.title: Prepare Elution plate
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 25 mM Tris‑HCl to each sample well of the Elution plate according to the plate map.

steps.title: Assemble Lysis/Bind plate
steps.instruction: Vortex the Resin for 15‑20 seconds, add 35 µL Resin to each sample well, then add 300 µL concentrated wastewater sample (or 300 µL Cell Lysis Buffer for the extraction blank). Finally add 400 µL of 100 % isopropanol to each well.

steps.title: Prepare Ethanol plate
steps.instruction: Add 450 µL of 50 % ethanol solution to each sample well of the Ethanol plate as indicated on the plate map.

steps.title: Insert tip comb
steps.instruction: Insert a KingFisher 96‑Tip Comb for DW Magnet into a sixth KingFisher Deep Well 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Prepare bulk reagents
steps.instruction: Pipette 30 mL of molecular‑grade 100 % isopropanol into a 50 mL conical tube. In a second 50 mL conical tube, pipette 25 mL sterile molecular‑grade water followed by 25 mL 200‑proof ethanol; invert gently to mix a 50 % ethanol solution. Add 50 µL of Alkaline Protease solution to the sample wells as required.

steps.title: Select KingFisher program
steps.instruction: On the KingFisher Flex menu screen, select the program titled “Promega Maxwell HT RNA Wastewater V1”.

steps.title: Load plates and start run
steps.instruction: Slide the KingFisher Flex door open, press Start, and follow the instrument prompts to load all 96‑well plates (A1 corner in the upper‑right corner of each tray). Close the door and start the program, which runs for 1 hour 15 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to new plate
steps.instruction: When the program finishes, remove all plates as instructed, discard Wash 1, Wash 2, Ethanol, Lysis/Bind, and Tip plates per biosafety protocol, keep the Elution plate, and transfer the entire volume (~200 µL) of extracted nucleic material from each well of the Elution plate to a round‑bottom sterile 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Seal and store eluate
steps.instruction: Cover the sterile 96‑well plate with an aluminum sealing film. Store the plate at 4 °C if analysis will occur the same day; otherwise store at –70 °C or below for up to 2 years.
